comment: Each counter's reset button and reset input share one dsp::SchmittTrigger inside a single || expression (src/MentalCounters.cpp:81 and 102), so the trigger is handed two different values per sample and a steady high voltage at a reset input fires a reset every sample; the counter is therefore held at zero for as long as the voltage stays high rather than reset once. The knob is configured 1 to 32 and rounded (src/MentalCounters.cpp:65). The display is a TransparentWidget added with addChild and has no ParamWidget, so it is not in the census position lists and no click can reach it. The panel prints Counters, Clk In, Out and Reset.
